Tara B.: Customer cust-901 disputed INV-7345 — shows ~11k burst tokens billed in both apac-edge and apac-failover for the same minute ranges. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_7345.pdf :grimacing:
Ethan M.: Can you paste the offending lines and billing window?
Tara B.: Window 2026-11-20 -> 2026-12-19. Condensed export: ```id,desc,pool,committed,used,burst,amount
M9001,Reserved commit - apac-edge,apac-edge,100000,98000,0,5000.00
M9002,Burst - apac-edge,apac-edge,100000,11000,11000,550.00
M9003,Burst - apac-failover,apac-failover,0,11000,11000,550.00
M9004,Reserved commit - apac-failover,apac-failover,40000,39000,0,2000.00
``` Duplicate burst looks like ~$550 duplicated.
metering-bot: Metering event me-11422: 2026-12-05T08:42:12Z - live-migration initiated for cust-901. Vendor ack delay observed: vendor feed VEND-721 lagged by ~18 minutes during migration. Logs: /meters/me-11422.log and /vendor/vend-721/lag_20261205.log
Ravi S.: Runtime note: our migration flow re-issued tags to the new pool while the old pool continued to record tail traffic. Vendor delay means vendor reported the same stream twice (once under origin tag, once under new tag). That produces two billable lines.
Tara B.: Customer thread says they saw increased latency briefly. They want an immediate corrected invoice and explanation.
Ethan M.: Policy: when duplication comes from internal re-tagging + vendor double-reporting, we credit duplicate burst fully and fix proration/tax if impacted. Required artifacts: (1) token-hash dedupe showing identical token ids in overlapping windows, (2) migration event log, (3) vendor lag logs showing double-report, (4) mapping of both line items to cust-901.
Clara (Finance): Finance provisional approval: up to $700 credit pending verification. JE code 10-301-BILL; memo "migration duplicated burst cust-901". Final after dedupe and vendor reconciliation.
infra-bot: Filing INFRA-1112 to persist ingress origin_tag through migration to prevent re-tagging. ETA 7 days. Also filing VEND-721 ticket to request corrected consolidated usage feed.
Ravi S.: Kicked off token dedupe for 2026-12-05T08:30 -> 2026-12-05T09:05. Export: /exports/cust-901/20261205_token_hashes.csv. ETA 4h.
Tara B.: Created billing case BILL-2026-912 and put INV-7345 on hold until 2026-12-20. Uploaded condensed CSV, migration logs, and vendor lag logs. I'll update the customer with a provisional note once dedupe confirms duplication. :thumbsup:
